about.bio: I'm a student who built HanziNarrative as a self-learning project — combining a passion for learning Mandarin with the desire to build something genuinely useful. Every feature here grew out of my own learning experience.
about.projectP1: HanziNarrative is an HSK 1–6 Mandarin learning app built around storytelling — you learn vocabulary and grammar through interactive stories, not boring rote memorization.
about.projectP2: Features include spaced-repetition flashcards, character writing, pinyin typing practice, AI conversation, multiplayer battle mode, gamification with XP & badges, and much more — all in one platform.
about.techHint: Hover or tap a badge to see why it was chosen
about.contactText: Have a suggestion, a bug report, or just want to say hi? Reach out via email or the social links above. Feedback is much appreciated!
